messages:
Rae (Partnerships): Quick sync 1 testing a new gateway for marketplace -> SI handoffs. want to lock the rules before we flip.
Ibrahim (SI): ok whats the idea?
Rae (Partnerships): marketplace leads go into a short alignment window (48h). Sales + SI confirm account mapping. if SI confirms, we lock to SI. otherwise Sales keeps it.
Cal (Sales): 48h seems fine. need an expedite fast-path for customers asking partner intro same day.
Nora (Sales Ops): can add an expedite flag on intake and fields in SFDC: handoff_state, claim_ts, si_rel_flag, expedite_flag, alignment_deadline. opsbot pseudo:
if si_rel_flag or expedite_flag:
  owner = si_owner
else:
  owner = gateway_alignment_queue; alignment_deadline = now + 48h
intakebot: new lead GW-211 created (origin: cloud-marketplace). account=HelioWare, region=NA, tags=[marketplace,hw-partner], si_rel_flag=false
Ibrahim (SI): also propose: if partner CRM shows active relationship -> immediate claim. plus a 24h no-outreach buffer after claim.
Cal (Sales): dedupe by canonical domain, then parent_company. for ambiguous subsidiaries auto-sched a 10m triage call between rep + SI.
Rae (Partnerships): next steps: Nora to add SFDC fields in sandbox (EOD Thu), Ibrahim to run two dry-run leads (normal + expedite), Partnerships to publish a 1-page partner ROE.
Nora (Sales Ops): will add dashboard widgets: avg time-to-claim and % expedited.
Ibrahim (SI): will test and report back. target pilot flip Tue 9am PT if green.
Rae (Partnerships): I'll drop the ROE + short partner note here for review. thanks all.
